theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

shared_equivalence.scope: Actual production VLM segment kernel and coupled collocation solve versus independent adaptive Biot-Savart quadrature
shared_equivalence.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

primary_sources.title: W.H. Mason, Applied Computational Aerodynamics, Chapter6: Vortex Lattice Methods (1998)
primary_sources.scope: Actual production VLM segment kernel and coupled collocation solve versus independent adaptive Biot-Savart quadrature

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

Actual per-model production VLM solve versus independent pivoted-QR boundary-condition solve
case_records.scope: Actual source geometry and actual production coupled VLM; disclosed minimum lattice, not production-table resolution/convergence/calibration

case_records.name: Actual native wind-force/body-CG moment conversion versus independent orthonormal basis transport

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

primary_sources.title: W.H. Mason, Applied Computational Aerodynamics, Chapter6: Vortex Lattice Methods (1998)
primary_sources.scope: Actual production VLM segment kernel and coupled collocation solve versus independent adaptive Biot-Savart quadrature

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.

theory.equations: u(P)=Gamma/(4*pi) integral dl cross (P-r)/|P-r|^3; A_ij=n_i dot u_j(P_i); A*Gamma=-n dot V_external; dF=rho*Gamma*(V_local cross dl); nondimensionalize force by q*S and moment by q*S*[b,c,b]; Body force from native wind coefficients: q*S*(-CD*x_w+CY*y_w-CL*z_w)

theory.limits: Inviscid thin-surface VLM is not viscous transonic CFD. Far-separation/reverse-flow/high-Mach/stall behavior relies on stated engineering closures, not measured OEM polars. The off-filament reference does not validate finite-core singular behavior, every generated polar or all Mach/alpha/beta regimes.
theory.delta: Shared VLM generation method does not imply identical lifting surfaces/body/fin geometry, airfoil/source assumptions, native tables or control derivatives. Each24 source design and generated native table container is independently hash-bound.
theory.state: Offline coupled surface geometry/lattice and nonlinear section/body closures generate serialized native tables. At runtime JSBSim evaluates actual alpha/beta/Mach/control state, sums physical loads and transports moments to current CG. The wrapper adds no replacement force model.
theory.io: TOML real surface/body geometry, airfoil curves, controls and reference dimensions -> coupled aerodynamic coefficient/control tables -> native state-dependent force/moment. Native output and tables, not descriptor names, determine actual behavior.
theory.discretization: Quarter-chord bound vortices/three-quarter-chord collocation; wake-direction interpolation, Vatistas finite cores, subsonic PG transformation, nonlinear decambering/section blend and tabulated native interpolation. Tests compare an off-filament zero-core primitive and a coupled collocation solve to independent numerical line integration.
theory.uncertainty: Actual model geometry/reference dimensions/control derivatives differ in each source/native XML hash. Descriptor empty parameter_refs is accompanied by actual design/XML inputs. No calibration claim follows from exact Biot-Savart agreement; whole native flight/loads and model-specific uncertainty remain separate.
